author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಸ್ಮಿತೆಯೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರೆ ಜೀವವಿಹ ಶವದಂತೆ
ವಿಸ್ಮಯವೆ ಜಗವೆಂದು ತನ್ನತನವುಳಿಯೆ
ವಿಸ್ಮರಣೆ ಜನಕೊಲಿಯೆ ಕೆಡುಕುಗಳ ಮರೆವುದಕೆ
ಸುಸ್ಮಿತವೆ ಭವಿತವ್ಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Without a sense of self, you are like a living corpse;
keep your selfhood, and the world is a wonder;
when forgetting comes easily, to forget the wrongs of others,
the future is smiling, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Keep a healthy sense of self and the world stays full of wonder. Learn to forget the harm others did, and the future smiles on you.
